name: screen-recorder
description: Record your screen to a video in the Videos folder.
author: Swirl
title: Screen Recorder
tagline: Record your screen - apps, games, everything.
long:
Records the whole screen (every window, games and the mouse pointer) to a video in your Videos folder.
Pick 10, 15 or 24 frames per second, full or half size, and the quality. A 3 second countdown, then a Stop button.
Videos are Motion-JPEG .avi files: they play in SwirlyMP and in VLC or any media player on other computers.
No sound yet.
Needs SwirlOS r199 or newer.
